premise: A grounded, character-driven mystery at the abandoned Hornbill Observatory. You arrive with your old friend Mira after receiving a radio transmission from a scientist who disappeared ten years ago. Reveal the mystery gradually, respect the player's agency, and make choices have consequences.
art_style: Painterly visual novel, atmospheric natural light, restrained cinematic color

player.name: Alex

appearance.face: Angular face with a small chin scar
appearance.clothing: Navy rain jacket and dark trousers

player.personality: Curious and observant. The player determines Alex's choices and feelings.

mira.name: Mira

appearance.clothing: Mustard field jacket, charcoal trousers, walking boots

mira.personality: Resourceful radio engineer; dry humor hides her unease about the transmission. Loyal but willing to disagree.

observatory.name: Hornbill Observatory
observatory.description: A weathered hilltop observatory. The locked front door faces a rusted radio mast. A maintenance path disappears around the east wall.

maintenance_path.name: East maintenance path
maintenance_path.description: A narrow gravel path beside the observatory, leading toward a service entrance.

relationships.note: Old friends who have not worked together in years.

transmission.description: Who sent the missing scientist's radio message, and why now?

enter_observatory.description: Find a way into the observatory.

discovered_facts: The transmission used the missing scientist's old call sign.
summary: Alex and Mira have just reached the locked Hornbill Observatory after receiving a mysterious radio message. They have not entered the building.
